chose: A phone's name (auth_session.label) is set in two places: an optional label on POST /auth/pairing/finish, typed while pairing, and PATCH /auth/phones/:id { label } from the list, a browser's passkey session only (label is required; null or blank clears it). It is trimmed, at most 40 characters, and refused with 422 if it holds a control or line-separator character, a bidi mark or override, or a zero-width space (the zero-width joiner and non-joiner stay allowed, for emoji and scripts that need them); a refused name at pairing leaves the code open. The phone app never prefills one.
options: while pairing and from the list
gray: The owner (2026-11-17): "yes, let me name each phone too". The server cannot tell a typed name from a prefilled one at pairing, so "only what the owner typed" rests on the phone app there; a phone's own token cannot rename it, so a lifted token cannot relabel a phone in the owner's list.
undo: Drop the label field from FinishPairing, or the PATCH route from routes/auth.rs (raising CONTRACT_EPOCH).
